youtube_description:
An associate professor of planetary science at Purdue and Mars Rover scientist soon will have an opportunity of a lifetime with NASA. For this project, she can let her imagination dive into the geology of Mars as part of the NASA Mars rover Perseverance mission, which is approaching the halfway point to Mars.

More about Dr. Briony Horgan's passion and NASA project: https://www.purdue.edu/newsroom/releases/2020/Q4/purdue-scientist-reflects-on-her-passion-for-studying-mars-geology,-landscape.html

Listen to This Is Purdue featuring Dr. Briony Horgan: https://youtu.be/sR6NckO3ItQ

#Purdue #Mars #TheNextGiantLeap
youtube_title: Mars Rover scientist and Purdue Professor reflects on her passion for studying Mars
